question: Should this personal profile replace curated project links with externally rendered PinMe cards?
rationale: The request changes the profile’s visual voice and adds a third-party live-image dependency, choices that VISION.md explicitly reserves for the profile owner.

options.title: Keep Curated Links
options.body: Retain the current concise list and decline the card service unless a concrete profile need emerges.

options.title: Evaluate One Card
options.body: Request reliability, privacy, proxy-rendering, and maintenance proof before trialing one narrowly scoped card.

recommendation.title: Keep Curated Links
recommendation.body: Retain the current concise list and decline the card service unless a concrete profile need emerges.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns the profile’s editorial direction and has directly curated the affected README section.
